notes.title: Thank you Summer players, new and old!
notes.notes: [p]Hello new and old players![/p][p][/p][p]Wanted to take a second to thank everyone who has picked up 24K during the Steam Summer Sale! We're trying to hit the 500 review / 98% positive milestone, so I kindly ask that you leave a review.[/p][p][/p][p]A 24K performance update was in the works because long sessions can lead to built up memory and possibly crashes on some computers. I've had mixed results in optimization, and Flash development is slow and taxing compared to modern engines. I hope you can forgive me for pausing the development on that. I have a full time job outside of gamedev and I've chosen to allocate my limited free time to working on a new game. If this is plaguing you, a workaround in the meantime is restarting the game if your session is exceeding 4+ hours.[/p][p][/p][p]The new game we're working on is a variety puzzle game. Rafael (Lead of 24K's QA and Brazilian localization) is more involved this time, helping with level design and much more. I can't reveal anything about it yet, but we're in full swing and you can expect the same amount of 24K love and eccentricity.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care and have a great Summer,[/p][p][/p][p]Todd & Team[/p][p]Happy Shabby Games[/p]

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone who's picked up 24K in the Steam Spring Sale!

Please consider taking a few minutes to leave a short review. My goal is to get 500 reviews at 98% positive so I can get Steam's fabled "Overwhelmingly Positive" status. We're so close too! It will help the game's visibility in the store, and help me in future endeavors. 

Spring is in the air and I'm starting to focus on new projects, so I don't want to get anyone's hopes up for future content updates or major gameplay changes. An optimization and fan translation update is in the works. That being said, any feedback on 24K is still helpful so I can improve the next 24K-like! It's a formula that I think is worth improving and exploring more. I do read the negative reviews and appreciate people voicing what they would have liked to see in the game.

Thank you for your support, and have a wonderful Spring Break!

Todd


P.S. - I installed a weather vane similar to the one in 24K on top of the Happy Shabby Games Shedquarters ;?)

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
I wanted to say thank you to everyone picking up 24 Killers this season, and use this opportunity to remind people to leave a review of their experience! We're sitting at 272 reviews (98% positive) at the moment, and my dream is to get it up to 500 while keeping the same ration in order to get the "overwhelmingly positive" status on Steam. It helps greatly.

In other news, I'm working on an optimization update that will improve performance and memory use. I'm going back through old code and improving it with gusto. Some people are running into memory related crashes during long sessions and my goal is to stop that from happening. This will not halt your progress, but can be  annoying and confusing. If you've experienced a crash or lock, it's likely due to this. [u]Relaunching the application will clear the memory and let you continue on[/u]. This is a good preventative measure too if you're deep in the shabbyverse of 24K.

Happy Holidays, Merry Christmas, and Happy New Year!

Todd

notes.title: Fix For "Quickly Now!" Achievement
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

A community member let me know that the "Quickly Now!" achievement wasn't triggering for beating the game in less than 24 days. This build will correct that, and retroactively give you the achievement if you were affected by this. All you have to do is go to the file select screen and the game scans your files to see if any are beaten in under 24 days. I put it out on the beta branch first for that community member to test and everything seems to be working.

Hope you're all having a wonderful Summer. Take care.

Todd

notes.title: Regular Spawn Fix Update
notes.notes:
Had an interesting bug reported in the Discord. The player had a pre Summer update save, downloaded the update, deleted their old save, and started a new game. A shop variable from the pre summer version somehow carried over to the new save they started and prevented the Regular from spawning. This is a fix for anyone who experienced that. No need to restart your save or anything. Should automatically get her shop to spawn after talking to her on the beach.

Let me know if there are any issues, and take care,

Todd

notes.title: Review Reminder
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I wanted to reach out and ask that if you've enjoyed 24K, please take a few moments to leave a review. I don't feel like this is a strange or shameful thing to ask because, well, I'm small potatoes compared to bigger indies. Reviews help the game's visibility on Steam and currently only about 6% of players have left a review. I'd love to bring another happy shabby adventure to life, and if you've already picked up 24K, this is a free way to support my future games in a big way. Thank you all for the support. I couldn't ask for a better group of players.

Take care,

Todd

I also updated the credits to include the artist of the new title screen and Steam promo art.

Thank you guys and apologies for any inconvenience. This update won't fix any saves that were effected, but you can hop into our Discord to find me, and I'm happy to fix your save personally.

notes.title: (Fixed)Progression Bug with New Summer Build!
notes.notes:
(This bug has been fixed, please update to the newest build. Thank you!)

Good morning!

I thought all was well with the new build, but I got a report this morning from a Discord member that some mon cutscenes and photo events are getting mixed up and preventing progression. Here's what could be happening to you (quote from Discord):

[b]"I’m struggling to get passed when piggle and nix are let out of the vault. After getting the key from the ship and then going to sleep after helping all the mons that day (all the mons after the final toast lock that I could help) it shows all the cutscenes and then piggle appears like how a ghost mon would and just says “mad” and disappears. It keeps doing this and It’s funny, but I tried continuing and it kept doing the same cutscene and then piggle would be bagged again and then I’d get multiple photos that were from piggle but just labelled as photos separately. Also, nix’s quest would never occur even after helping the second to last ghost mon and having the document and memory stick. I thought at first it may have been because I put in the key code before meeting the cat who gave you the document, but I deleted my save and retried it normally and the same thing has happened again."[/b]

I made some changes to mon progression which is probably what's causing this issue. I'm working on a fix right now and hope to get a patch out today. If I'm not able to pin this down quickly, I'll roll the public build back to the last stable build.

I'm sorry that this slipped through.


Todd

notes.title: Summer Update Now Live & Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
The Summer update is now live!

06262024
fixes:
brazilian text missing tutorial text for shamrock
in-game menu not disappearing after pressing "return to title"
void music turning off after pocketing a blessing during intro
weird effects if you activate huey's minigame before turning in oyaji's photo
photo location for ghost mons always reading "rest"

changes:
bed stars! a star floats above your bed for each cutscene that will occur at night. this is to help people know if sleeping will change something so they don't waste their time sleeping. it's also a good indicator if you're stuck. the presence of stars means something will occur at night, the absence of stars means there is something that needs doing on the island presently

regular now triggers a cutscene the night she opens her shop showing the flash item. this is to remind players about her and give more utility to the bed stars

if you free huey, then beat oyaji's minigame, huey's minigame will be available immediately instead of having to sleep to progress

screen transitions!

cursed blessing days reduced to 7 from 24!!

when activating a mon's minigame or item quest, their photo appears in your inventory, half transparent with an exclamation mark next to it, to show you haven't collected it yet. this way players can see what mons they haven't helped and where they're located. once you actually get their photo, the exclamation goes away and the icon becomes opaque

new alternate track by FesliyanStudios added for the main outdoor areas. slide guitar blues fits the island's vibe very well

new title screen art by Discord member Shu Bi! You can check out their website [url=https://shrewbean.neocities.org/]here [/url]

raised settings menu screen position so it's more centered

----------------------------------------------------------------

Really excited for new and seasoned players to try this update. The bed stars that indicate if events will happen at night, and photos now acting as a pseudo quest log, feel like needed QoL features that will benefit everyone. 

Besides small bug fixes, this will be the last update for a while so I can focus on making new games. Thanks for your continued support, and please share 24K with your friends during the Summer Sale!

Todd

notes.title: Summer Sale Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Hope you're having a lovely Spring. Wanted to let you know I'm putting some ideas together for a small Summer update based on feedback and personal "wishlist" things.

-updated title screen with new art
-more BGM variety for the main areas
-cool screen transitions, something i always wish the game had
-bug fixes. anyone notice that when you pick up a blessing during the intro the BGM stops?
-a very light kind of hint or "compass" system (optional toggle) that helps point players toward objectives to make the game more accessible for modern/casual gamers. i'll also try to encourage people to seek help here or the discord when toggling this option because it's important to 24K's experience to have some skin in the game as a player whether it's paying attention to dialogue or seeking help from the community

I'm still interested in marketing 24K and supporting it. It's been so encouraging to hear from people in the Discord and X about their love for the game. Still have my hopes up that it will reach a wider audience and gain that "Overwhelmingly Positive" status on Steam. So please drop a review or share the game with a friend if you haven't!

Have a great week and expect an update for the Summer Sale!

Todd

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971997/27785a1c7a4d3a2b6cc6e594079022e1eb156175.png[/img]

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year from us at Happy Shabby Games!

Thank you everyone for your continued support, and enjoy!

notes.title: v05212023 Daily Auto Save Backup
notes.notes:
v05212023

news:
steam auto cloud saves will be coming soon! read below about the new auto backup feature that will help prevent possible save data loss by those who play the game on two or more devices. 24K will only sync your save data, not config files, because you may have different settings across devices. I encourage players to also make their own local safety save if you plan on playing between two or more devices and using the auto cloud.

changes:
save backup feature added. when you save, a daily shadow copy of your whole 24k data is stored in appdata/roaming/24Killers/local store. for example, whenever you save on may 21st 2023, a folder will be made for that date and the shadow copy of your data will be updated every time you save until the next day when it will create a new folder and start a new shadow copy. save data location may vary on steam deck. see our discord FAQ for more information.

Please let me know if you encounter any new issues with this build, and take care.

Todd

notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves and Backup Feature
notes.notes:
Good morning!

I've been testing Steam's auto cloud save in 24 Killers and have it working! Something I noticed is if you're using the game between two devices with auto cloud, it's possible to overwrite the data you wanted to keep by syncing the other device's data first.

Ahead of making cloud saves available to users, there will be an update soon that makes a daily local backup of your save data every time you save. For instance, if I save my game today, it will generate a directory "Backup Saves/05202023/" and copy my 24k_foam.sol to that folder. If I save again, that file will be updated until the next day when it will make a "05212023" folder and start copying my save there instead. I hope this will help prevent some frustration, and I still encourage people to make their own local save backup.

Have a great weekend,

Todd


(announcement artwork by @CASUALRAD)

notes.title: Update v04022023 In-Game Patch notes, Box/Chest/Bowl Spawns, Music Overlap
notes.notes:
v04022023

You'll notice that there are now in-game patch notes that read directly from the change log file in your game files!

Important!!
Existing save files may have boxes/toasters/bowls spawning again after having opened them. I improved the code for these spawns and as a consequence, some of them may show up again. I don't anticipate this breaking anyone's saves.

fixes:
overlapping music when talking to NPCs sometimes
tad talking about the broken handle after completing their minigame and before breaking the handle
pausing the game while a menu is open, then unpausing and accidentally selecting an option with the same input
huey's tv not being cracked until getting oyaji photo. should be cracked after oyaji throws it
not able to interact with cats or muscle mons after getting their challenge text when their event is active
not able to interact with muscle mons after exiting menu or finishing "rules" cutscene on the TV
squat rules menu option breaking the minigame if you view rules and exit the map
treadmill sprite adding so many frames from speed that treadmill appears still

changes:
new dialogue for wormy and skip after all the mons are freed and they're not running on the treadmill anymore.
event trigger in jpd hub where johnny tells home he can't access the next part of the dungeon only occurs now after you've beaten the first boss and you don't have a ghost power yet.
you can pick up big gabbage again at lvl 3 strength. you still get the message about needing a suitable vessel before then
added red pulse to Nix's ship in forest
pausing the game now pauses music
added alt color for home's dialogue portrait
changed item above Gunther's house in cursed box
changed item in fish bowl in forest near ship
changes to box code (bowls, boxes, cursed boxes) may cause some boxes to respawn on existing saves
cooking boltzmann gives you nana bread
treadmill shakes when the max animation speed is reached

Please let me know of any issues you encounter. Thank you guys!

Todd

added 3 auto text speed options. the fastest option displays all text at once
gabbage can picks up poo poo now

changes:
light vault blessing changed to light elevator
new text when trying to throw monster gabbage. players getting confused by "requires lvl 3"

notes.title: Small Fixes!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for an amazing launch. I was expecting a much more substantial day one patch, but things have gone surprisingly smooth.

Here is the change log for this update (also found in your game files and dates back a year):

fixes:
BP text update for settings menu
invalid bitmap error on the sun/moon entity
sun/moon spawning on every single map, out of sight, even when not necessary
sequence break using bubble whisper over bramble to get into the forest early. this is cool but is causing a lot of confusion for players
mons being able to invite themselves over when you're driving the taxi

changes:
slight to moderate performance increase from sun/moon only spawning on vault map now

There was a sequence break found that was very cool, but it was causing confusion for a lot of players. If you caught the updraft of a Bubble Whisper east of Moon's ship in the forest, you could fly over the bramble and skip a decent portion of the game. It didn't break your save, but it confused players who, after doing the sequence break, felt like they were stuck.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello! 

This is Todd, 24 Killers' sole developer. Ahead of the launch this Thursday (March 9th) I wanted to reach out to everyone who is planning on enjoying the game. I've been working hard with our small community of testers to make sure this is a smooth experience for everyone. I anticipate a stable, functional experience for the vast majority of players.

If you do happen to run into an issue or bug, I will be present Thursday through Sunday, all day, and paying attention to this community and our Discord to fix bugs that are reported. Please have patience with me during the launch, and consider sharing your issue so we can get it resolved and get you back into the world of 24K.

Your time is valuable and I appreciate you supporting 24 Killers. See you all on Thursday!

notes.title: 24 Killers Available March 9, 2023

We're happy to announce 24 Killers will be available through Steam for PC in English and Brazilian Portuguese on March 9, 2023!

Thank you and see you all at launch!
